model: mask-full-probe-v21a (hssr_mask.bin): the per-cell rear-eligibility student, run as the control worker's third job; provenance and the DEV row in manifest.json
harness: stereo_upmix_render --mask-model v21a.msk1 --mask-drive-prod 1.0 --vocal-gate 0.5 on top of VARIANTS['shipped'] (upmix_stem_tests.py --render-extra)

AUDIO_HSSR_MASK_MODEL.what: unset = hssr_mask.bin beside AUDIO_HSSR_MODEL; absent file = mask off

AUDIO_HSSR_MASK_DRIVE.what: object = sqrt(eligibility) * drive, pan = the bin's own L/R balance; 0 = off (the heuristic object path), range 0..2; three late controls fall back to the heuristic path

AUDIO_HSSR_VOCAL_GATE.what: the soft veto over the mask (see models/hssr-selection-v11/settings.json)
